title: FoundSurface: Feedforward Ray-Based 3D Scene Surface Reconstruction from Unposed Images
abstract: arXiv:2611.34128v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate 3D surface reconstruction from unposed images remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision. Recent feed-forward pointmap methods eliminate the need for camera poses but inherently produce discrete, sparse representations. In this paper, we present a generalizable pipeline that directly recovers continuous, high-fidelity 3D surfaces from unposed images by seamlessly integrating pointmap- and ray-based representations. Our approach first extracts explicit geometric priors using a pre-trained pointmap model. A query-view-centric selection module then identifies geometrically relevant reference views via a robust surfel voting mechanism. Next, a cross-attention regressor bridges target query rays with reference features to estimate a continuous coarse surface. Lastly, a raylet-based module aggregates local 3D features to carve out high-frequency details and analytical normals. Trained as a single foundation model on 9 divers

translated_title: FoundSurface：基于前馈射线的无位姿图像三维场景表面重建
translated_abstract: 从无位姿图像中进行精确的三维表面重建仍然是计算机视觉中的一项根本性挑战。近期的前馈点图方法虽然摆脱了对相机位姿的依赖，但其本质上产生的是离散、稀疏的表示。本文提出了一个可泛化的流水线，通过无缝融合基于点图和基于射线的两种表示，直接从无位姿图像中恢复连续、高保真的三维表面。我们的方法首先利用预训练的点图模型提取显式几何先验；随后，一个以查询视图为中心的选择模块通过鲁棒的面元投票机制识别几何上相关的参考视图；接着，一个交叉注意力回归器将目标查询射线与参考特征相桥接，以估计连续的粗糙表面；最后，一个基于raylet（射线片段）的模块聚合局部三维特征，从而刻画出高频细节和解析法线。该方法作为一个单一基础模型在9个多样化数据集上训练。
tldr: 该论文提出FoundSurface，通过无缝融合点图与射线表示构建前馈流水线，以面元投票选择参考视图、交叉注意力回归估计粗糙表面、raylet模块刻画高频细节与解析法线，从而直接从无位姿图像重建连续、高保真的三维场景表面。
en_tdlr: FoundSurface is a generalizable feedforward pipeline that seamlessly integrates pointmap and ray-based representations—via surfel voting for reference view selection, cross-attention regression for coarse surface estimation, and a raylet module for high-frequency details and analytical normals—to directly reconstruct continuous, high-fidelity 3D scene surfaces from unposed images.
